summary: Iteration 13 — validated new P0 features: (A) Form Submissions Inbox backend (POST/GET/DELETE /api/submissions) and (B) relocation of Design/Code/Preview mode toggle out of TopBar into a new center-pane wrapper. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestSubmissions (8 new tests). Full pytest run: 61/61 passed (previous 53 + 8 new). New tests cover: JSON POST with _wd_* meta parsed into form_id/form_name/page_url/page_title + arbitrary fields under data (GET verifies persistence and no _id leak); form-urlencoded POST with Accept: application/json returns JSON {ok,id}; form-urlencoded POST with Accept: text/html returns HTML thank-you page (contains 'Thanks!'); empty submission (only reserved keys) returns 400 with 'No form fields were submitted'; GET filter by form_name works and unrelated filter returns []; list ordered newest-first (created_at desc); DELETE one 200+ok true, GET after 404; DELETE unknown returns 404; DELETE ?form_name=X returns {ok,deleted:>=1}. Frontend Playwright (1920x1080, tour skipped via Skip button): (1) Center pane data-testid='center-pane' contains the mode-toggle exactly once with mode-design/mode-code/mode-preview; TopBar contains undo-btn + redo-btn visible with NO mode-toggle inside it (single toggle instance globally, located under center-pane). (2) Submissions modal opens via submissions-btn; modal shows submission-group-all + per-form-name groups and submissions-refresh works. (3) Full end-to-end: Forms tab → open-form-builder → form-name-inbox defaults to 'Contact form', form-action defaults to '<REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL>/api/submissions'; renamed to 'TEST_it13_ui', clicked form-insert; switched to mode-preview, filled 3 non-hidden inputs (name/email/message) with marker TEST_ui_marker_xyz, submitted the form inside the preview iframe (sandbox allow-forms allow-same-origin allow-scripts). Injected fetch AJAX script fired: form was replaced with the inline green 'Thanks! We'll be in touch.' message (visible in screenshot) with NO iframe navigation. Backend GET /api/submissions?form_name=TEST_it13_ui returned 1 record with all three fields containing the marker string, form_id auto-generated (form-s99r7x), page_url='about:srcdoc', page_title='Untitled'. (4) Reopened Inbox: submission-group-TEST_it13_ui appears with 1 entry, submission-row-<id> contains marker text; UI delete via submission-delete-<id> removed the row (dcount 1→0) and produced 'Submission deleted' toast (screenshot). (5) mode-code click switches middle pane to CodeView (codeview-html/codeview-css testids present). (6) Regression: 0 non-sandbox console errors. The only console noise is 'Blocked script execution in about:srcdoc … allow-scripts not set' — this originates from Left-Sidebar ComponentThumbnail iframes (which intentionally sandbox WITHOUT allow-scripts), NOT the preview iframe. Preview iframe scripts run correctly (verified by inline success message).
critical_code_review_comments: Submission model stores arbitrary user-supplied form fields under `data` without size limits — a malicious POST could bloat the collection. Consider a max body-size guard (already limited by FastAPI defaults, but explicit len(data)/value length caps would be safer) and rate limiting per IP.

buildFormHtml() injects a small inline <script> that intercepts submit and calls fetch(action, {method:'POST', body: new FormData(form), headers:{Accept:'application/json'}}). Works today, but when this HTML is exported/published to a real site with a strict CSP that forbids inline scripts, the AJAX fallback will silently fail and forms will do a full-page navigation to /api/submissions (which the same-origin restriction may block for cross-origin deploys). Consider (a) documenting the CSP requirement in the export flow, or (b) shipping the interceptor as an external file when exporting.

The preview iframe's srcdoc includes the form-submission <script>, and the sandbox correctly grants allow-scripts+allow-same-origin+allow-forms. Because the fetch runs in the same origin as the app, it succeeds. In production/exported sites this same script will POST cross-origin to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — the backend does allow_origins=['*'] in CORSMiddleware so this works, but be aware that changing that policy would break in-the-wild forms.
